messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting onboarding for orion-14b/q3-quant. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/orion/14b/q3/v2/weights/ and staged at /mnt/models/orion-14b-q3. Need a quick sanity check on continuous batching + caching before canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4281

ta o: noted — what's the tokenizer for this model? any quirks we should know?

maria: HF fast tokenizer (orion-tokenizer-v1). Found a quirk: when prompt starts with a leading newline the tokenizer emits an extra leading-space token which inflates token counts in the scheduler. Repro:```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('orion-tokenizer-v1', use_fast=True)
print(t.encode('
Hello'))  # shows extra token vs '\nHello' vs 'Hello'
```

kevin: for continuous batching I'd start with: `max_queue_latency_ms: 10`, `max_batch_tokens: 8192`, `max_batch_size: 24`. Enable `kv_cache_prefetch: true` only if memory headroom > 0.

andre: +1 to those. For cache settings suggest `prefix_cache_entries: 512` and `cache_eviction_policy: lru` for the canary. Also set `max_response_tokens: 1024` to reduce OOM risk on long tails.

jen: pinging on config schema validation — CI job `serving-ci/4281-config-check` failed with: `InvalidType: max_batch_tokens must be integer < 65536`. I pushed a tiny fix to the PR to coerce and validate.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2/cluster-3 (orion-14b-q3) — 2 pods — health OK :rocket:

maria: thanks. I'll run smoke requests to check latency and token accounting. Can someone review PR? @kevin @andre

kevin: reviewing now. Minor docstring nits, otherwise LGTM. Will approve after changes. :thumbsup:

tao: one more runtime note — there's a padding edge-case: if prompt_tokens + max_response_tokens > 16384 the scheduler used to crash. Please enable `response_truncation: true` in canary config so we don't hit that in prod.

maria: got it — updating PR to normalize tokenizer input (strip leading newlines) and enable `response_truncation: true`. Also adding small unit test for the tokenizer case.

jen: rollout plan in PR description: canary 2 pods for 30m, smoke traffic ~5rps, perf SLOs p50 < 120ms/step, p95 < 450ms/step. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% or memory > 90%.

maria: ack. posting smoke results in ~15m. If all green we'll promote and add dedicated cache tuning for Dedicated clusters later.

andre: quick note for ops — if you see spikes, try lowering `max_batch_tokens` to 4096 and increase `max_queue_latency_ms` to 20ms to smooth spikes.

maria: thanks all — committing PR updates now.
